purpose: Final English-accent listening audition using each already-approved race/gender timbre WAV as a fixed speaker reference. This is a pronunciation experiment, not a production geographic policy.
contentNotice: Fictional accent-direction audition for local voice design. Accent labels are exploratory and should not be treated as canon, real-world identity claims, or a production geography policy. The original 20 race/gender WAVs are fixed speaker references; all new samples reuse the exact same fixed text, matching seed, and CFG 4. Khajiit and Argonian receive the requested stronger scratchy texture; other timbres stay as established.
fixedText: Good day, traveller. The road ahead is long, but you are welcome to rest here for a while.

trialControls.seedPolicy: Reuse the exact seed from the matching original race/gender sample; no rerolls.
trialControls.speakerReferencePolicy: Use the corresponding successful WAV from race-voices-01 plus its exact transcript as fixed speaker reference.
trialControls.timbrePolicy: Preserve the existing race/gender timbre directions except explicitly strengthen Khajiit scratchy dry smoky rasp and Argonian scratchy deep guttural croak.
trialControls.isolationGoal: Audition English accent differences while holding reference speaker, text, seed, emotion, delivery and CFG fixed.
